 Serie A - Game Week 11 8 Nov 2026 - 06:30 Diego Armando Maradona DAZN will show Napoli v Lazio live and holds the rights to every Serie A match in 2026/27. The viewing options are below.
 Napoli host Lazio at the Diego Armando Maradona with both teams at a delicate point in their seasons, though for opposite reasons.
 Massimiliano Allegri's Napoli are struggling. A 2-0 league defeat to Juventus was followed by a 4-1 Champions League loss to Porto. Bednarek, Gabri Veiga and Kiwior scored, along with Samu from the penalty spot, after McTominay had equalised for Napoli in the first half. An on-pitch altercation between De Bruyne and Lucca exposed tensions within the squad, while Allegri faces growing scrutiny.
 By contrast, Lazio lead Serie A after ten matches and have won five in a row. Gennaro Gattuso's side beat Cagliari 2-1 last time out to maintain their excellent form.
 Captain Mattia Zaccagni injured a thigh against Cagliari, however, and could miss up to a month for Lazio. Gattuso appears inclined to start Andrea Pinamonti in his place, though Noslin remains a strong option.
 Napoli already have a long list of unavailable players, including Buongiorno, Di Lorenzo, Lobotka, Neres and Spinazzola. Allegri has De Bruyne and Hojlund back, but his side need to regain their cohesion and get results before the situation becomes irreversible.
 Fans can watch the match live on TV or via streaming.

 Injuries rule out Favasuli, Neres, Lobotka, Buongiorno, Alisson Santos, Spinazzola, Di Lorenzo and Olivera for Napoli, while Marianucci is suspended. Allegri is expected to start Meret in goal, with Beukema, Rafa Marín and Rrahmani in defence. Vergara, McTominay, Politano, De Bruyne, Anguissa and Gilmour are expected in midfield, with Hojlund up front.
 Lazio are without the injured Furlanetto, Gudmundsson and Zaccagni. Gattuso is set to start Mandas in goal, with Sutalo, Provstgaard and Floriani Mussolini in defence. Nuno Tavares, Frattesi, Taylor, Belahyane and Isaksen are expected in midfield, with Noslin and Cancellieri in the front three.
